The platform will offer A-share brokerage, underwriting, research, and principal trading services, enabling the bank to deepen client relationships and increase its investment-banking wallet share above 6%. This expansion aligns with Citigroup's OneCiti strategy and repositioning toward institutional banking in China following the sale of its consumer banking business to HSBC in 2024.

top.title: What's Powering Bank of America's Strong Capital Return Strategy?
top.summary: Bank of America demonstrates strong capacity for shareholder returns through robust earnings generation, healthy CET1 capital ratios, and disciplined balance-sheet management. The bank raised its quarterly dividend 14.3% to 32 cents per share and maintains $17 billion in remaining buyback authorization. Strong Q2 2026 results with $9.1 billion net income and 15% revenue growth support continued capital distributions, though a higher G-SIB surcharge from January 2027 may modestly increase capital requirements.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Capital Markets Momentum Fades: What it Means for Big Banks in Q3
top.summary: U.S. banks enter Q3 2026 with supportive lending conditions but face mixed capital markets trends. gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +2.5 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +2.5 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: How Wolverine's Strong Brand Portfolio Anchors Its Growth Strategy
top.summary: Wolverine World Wide reported 6.8% revenue growth in Q2 2026, with flagship brands Merrell (up 11.1%) and Saucony (up 9.9%) driving momentum. Despite headwinds from U.S. tariffs and gross-margin pressure, the company's diverse brand portfolio and global distribution support long-term growth prospects.

top.title: Can Victoria's Secret Keep PINK Growing After Five Strong Quarters?
top.summary: Victoria's Secret & Company (VSXY) reported that its PINK brand achieved high-single-digit growth for the fifth consecutive quarter, driven by strong performance in bras, panties, and apparel. The Marshmallow bra launch generated outsized results, and apparel has grown for eight consecutive quarters. Management expects intimates and apparel to reach a 50-50 mix over time, with significant growth opportunities ahead.

top.title: Can Boot Barn Continue to Expand Its Merchandise Margin?
top.summary: Boot Barn Holdings (BOOT) exceeded merchandise margin expectations in Q1 fiscal 2027 with a 220 basis point increase, driven by tariff refunds and stronger product margins. The company's work boots business showed robust demand, attracting new customers despite lower exclusive-brand penetration. Management raised full-year merchandise margin guidance to approximately 60 basis points expansion (excluding tariff refunds), supported by buying economies of scale, improved full-price selling, and supply-chain efficiencies.

A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Why Today's AI Boom Differs From the Internet Bubble

top.title: Building Automation System Market
top.summary: The building automation system market is undergoing structural transformation as hardware commoditizes while software, analytics, and building intelligence capture strategic value. The global BAS market, valued at $105.5 billion in 2026, is projected to reach $182.6 billion by 2033 at 8.2% CAGR. Key shifts include portfolio-level standardization replacing building-by-building procurement, cloud-based deployments displacing on-premise architectures, and cybersecurity becoming a primary procurement criterion. Large commercial owners are consolidating vendor relationships over the next 18 months, creating compounding advantages for early movers while independent system integrators face consolidation pressure.

top.title: Ulcerative Colitis Market Outlook: 5 Late-Stage Drug Candidates to Watch | DelveInsight
top.summary: The ulcerative colitis market is experiencing significant growth with emerging therapies addressing unmet needs in moderate-to-severe disease. The market, valued at approximately USD 9.4 billion in 2025, is projected to expand at a CAGR of 7.6% through 2036. top.title: Drug Repurposing Market to Reach USD 50.91 Billion by 2035, Expanding at 3.93% CAGR | SNS Insider

Small molecules dominate at 67% market share, with oncology and neurology as primary therapeutic areas. AI and machine learning are accelerating drug discovery, though intellectual property rights remain a key barrier.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +4.7 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +4.7 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Amgen Shares Fall as Novartis' Pelacarsen Misses Phase III Study Goal

The combination reduced disease progression or death risk by 56% compared to standard treatment. The FDA also approved Guardant360 CDx diagnostic test to identify patients with ESR1 mutations eligible for this therapy.

top.title: Nyxoah Annonce l’Implantation du Premier Patient dans BREATHE, l’Étude Post-Approbation Américaine du Système Genio®
top.summary: Nyxoah announced the first patient implantation in BREATHE, a post-approval U.S. study of its Genio® system for obstructive sleep apnea treatment. gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -8.3 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -8.3 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。
